summary.text: Christopher Ford is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Parke Wentling (R). He is a funeral director and a member of the Sharon City School District board.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Ford said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is the oldest of six siblings and the father of a 17-year-old son.

He said he serves on the Sharon City School Board and as Second Vice President of the Mercer County NAACP, and that he is a former union leader and a member of the Prince Hall Affiliated Masons and the Twin City Elks.
Ford said his brother was killed by gun violence in 2013 and that the loss motivates his commitment to safer communities.
He listed good-paying jobs, quality education, affordable healthcare, safe neighborhoods and economic growth among his priorities.
